craters.source: IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (USGS Astrogeology), MOON_nomenclature_center_pts
craters.filter: type 'Crater, craters', adopted by IAU, rim reaching lat <= -84.0

global_dem.encoding: gzip(int16 residuals of left+up-upleft predictor, high-byte plane then low-byte plane)
global_dem.layout: row 0 = 90 N, column 0 = 0 E, pixel registered (centres at (i + 0.5) / ppd deg)
global_dem.frame: Mean Earth/polar axis of DE421 (same as MOON_ME)
global_dem.source: LOLA GDR LDEM_16 (LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0, product version V3.1)
global_dem.size_decision: 16 ppd: lossless predictor+planes gzip 19,077,347 B <= 20,000,000 B (plain gzip would be 30,011,692 B)

fallback_texture.source: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit, 2025 colour map lroc_color_16bit_srgb_4k.tif (8-bit JPEG)
fallback_texture.credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, with LROC data from NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

craters_global.filter: adopted by IAU; types Crater, craters, Mare, maria, Mons, montes, Vallis, valles; lettered satellite craters excluded

illum_avg.meaning: average fraction of time sunlit (any part of the solar disc), percent 0..100
illum_avg.time_span: illumination averaged over a lunar precession cycle (18.6 years); LOLA topography 2009-07-13 to 2013-07-18
illum_avg.citation: Mazarico, E., et al. (2011), Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography, Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030

psr.meaning: permanently shadowed region: grey 255 = PSR, 0 = not
psr.time_span: illumination averaged over a lunar precession cycle (18.6 years); LOLA topography 2009-07-13 to 2013-07-18
psr.citation: Mazarico, E., et al. (2011), Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography, Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030

sites.source: pipeline/data/sites_source.csv (hand-curated; each row cites its fetched source_url)
